# RC Surface 2.0.0

Local candidate only. Eight configurable LFO/Stutter slots and two independently configurable Static/Physics XY panels.

Breaking change: configure performance, mappings and presets from scratch. Previous formats are not imported; existing files are left untouched.

Candidate artifact: `RC-Surface-2.0.0.ablx`. Verify `SHA256SUMS.txt` beside the local package. No tag or release has been published.

Guides: [English](../../docs/USER-GUIDE.md), [Português](../../docs/USER-GUIDE.pt-BR.md).

Physical phone/Live/MIDI acceptance remains pending.
